thread:
maya (Support): Customer reports JSON parse failures after model upgrade from redwood-v4.2 -> redwood-v4.3. They say arrays appear shifted and first element is null intermittently. Example response from customer:

customer: ```json
{\"items\": [null, {\"id\": \"abc\", \"label\": \"ok\"}, {\"id\":\"def\",\"label\":\"ok\"}]}\n```
They expected first element to be {\"id\": \"xyz\"}.

maya (Support): It's intermittent (~40% of requests) and aligns with the canary flip last night. Also saw latency bump ~5-10% in same window.

alec (ML Eng): Thanks. Can you paste the exact request payload + model params? Any correlation IDs? Did they change sampling / temperature?

maya (Support): Request body from customer:
```json
{\"model\":\"redwood-v4.3\",\n \"mode\":\"structured_output\",\n \"schema_version\":\"1.3\",\n \"input\": \"<redacted>\",\n \"max_tokens\":120,\n \"temperature\":0.0\n}\n```
Correlation ID: cid-qq9w-2026-03-12

sophia (SRE): deploy-bot shows canary started 2026-03-12T03:12Z -> `deployed redwood-v4.3 canary=15%` :rocket:

ryan (Oncall): Can we reproduce locally? @alec any tokenizer or generation changes between 4.2 and 4.3 that could shift array boundaries?

alec (ML Eng): There was a minor change removing a sentinel token; it should be backwards-compatible but could interact with prefix caching / streaming. Need a minimal repro. Maya, ask customer to turn streaming=false and send a small unredacted sample if possible.

maya (Support): Customer provided a redacted sample input:
```text
PROMPT: list items
- item A id: xyz
- item B id: abc
```
Their client validates with an index-based mapper which fails when the first element is null.

alec (ML Eng): Hypothesis: generation can emit an explicit null placeholder when chunk/kv-cache boundaries align poorly. Workarounds: pin to redwood-v4.2, set streaming=false, or post-process to drop leading nulls. I'll instrument traces.

sophia (SRE): Enabled extra logging for canary requests and added an alert for structured_output parse errors. Rolling back canary is on the table if customer impact >10%.

maya (Support): Customer agreed to pin to v4.2 for now. I'll coordinate and share correlation ids for affected requests.

deploy-bot: rollouts/17912: canary=15% -> canary=5% requested by sophia

ryan (Oncall): Next steps:
- alec: confirm sentinel removal interaction and create migration/fix or ensure placeholder suppression
- sophia: monitor errors and latency, consider rollback if spike continues
- maya: collect sample inputs + correlation ids from all affected customers

maya (Support): Noted. Sending repro + logs to eng channel.

alec (ML Eng): I can reproduce with their sample and am working on a patch to avoid emitting a null placeholder for structured schemas. ETA ~4h.

maya (Support): Thanks — customer appreciative of the fast response. :pray:
